messages.content: Calculate the probability of getting a head when flipping a coin.

message.content:
Assuming a fair coin (i.e., each side has an equal chance of landing face‑up), the probability of obtaining a head on a single flip is:

\[
P(\text{Head}) = \frac{\text{Number of favorable outcomes}}{\text{Total possible outcomes}}
               = \frac{1}{2}
               = 0.5 \quad (\text{or } 50\%).
\]

This result follows from the basic definition of probability and the assumption that the coin is unbiased and each flip is independent.
